hex.note: 56x64 near-regular hex; tiles tessellate exactly with these steps

meta.draw_order: environment first, then blend overlays in blend_priority order, then road overlay; rows top-to-bottom
meta.road_rotation: rotation k = canonical edges turned clockwise by k*60 degrees; every needed orientation is pre-rendered, never rotate sprites in-engine
meta.blend_rule: on a non-town tile, for each neighbouring env A later in blend_priority than the tile's env, draw blend_<A>_<edges> where edges are the sides touching A
meta.accent_frequency: use env *_accent on roughly 1 in 8-12 tiles of that environment
